title: Subscription
subtitle: Your DaleControl plan, what it includes and how your usage is going.

account.cancelScheduled: Cancels on {date}. Until then nothing changes.

notice.notConfigured: Online payments are not connected in this installation yet. Write to support and we will turn them on.
notice.stripeUnreachable: We could not read your billing data right now. Please try again in a minute.
notice.pendingPayment: Your account has no plan yet. Pick one to get into the panel.
notice.pastDue: Your last charge did not go through. Update your payment method so you do not lose access.
notice.canceled: Your subscription is canceled. You can subscribe again whenever you want.
notice.suspended: Your account was suspended by DaleControl. Please write to support.
notice.confirming: We are confirming your payment with the bank. It takes a few seconds.
notice.confirmSlow: Your payment went through, but the confirmation is taking a while. Reload in a minute; do not pay again.
notice.readOnly: Only the account owner can change the plan or the payment method.

usage.title: Your usage
usage.hint: What you have used against your plan's allowance.
usage.near: You have used {percent} % of this allowance.

plans.title: The plans
plans.hint: Prices and limits exactly as configured today. If they change, this screen changes on its own.

invoices.title: Payment history
invoices.hint: The latest movements on your subscription.
invoices.unavailable: The history is read from Stripe and it did not respond right now.
invoices.failed: The charge did not go through.

manage.title: Your billing account
manage.payMethodHint: Opens Stripe to change your card and see your invoices.
manage.cancelHint: It keeps working until the end of the period you already paid for.
manage.resumeHint: Removes the scheduled cancellation and everything goes on as before.

modal.changeUpgrade: You are moving up. Today we only charge the difference for the days left in this period.
modal.changeDowngrade: You are moving down. Nothing is charged today: you get a credit for your next invoice.
modal.keepsDate: Your renewal date does not move.
modal.dueTodayUnknown: We could not compute today's exact amount. Stripe will only charge the proportional part.
modal.overLimit: With this plan you stay above one of the allowances. Nothing is deleted, but you will not be able to add more until you free up space.
modal.cancelBody: Your plan keeps working until {date}. You will not be charged again and you can resume before that date.
modal.cancelBodyNoDate: Your plan keeps working until the end of the period you already paid for. You will not be charged again.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
